translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Bernabé, degi, Saulo barmilesad Bab-Jesús-igargi arbaegar

Antioquía-neggweburgine Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-abargi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad, degi, dulemar-odurdakmalad gudigusmarmogad. Amar Bernabé, Simón, Sichidye-bimarbalid, degi, Lucio-Cirenegined, agi Manaén, Rey-Herodes-tetrarca-ebo na dungusad, degi, Saulode.
Ibagwengi amar mas-gunsuli Bab Dummadse gorbukmargu, Bab Dummad Burba Nued ega sognonikid: “Bernabé, Saulo-ebo anga bachikii nugsamalo, adi an barmidega bia an oarbabi-gunaidse.”

Degiid-sorba, gwenadgan mas-gunsuli Babse gochamargu, a-sorba Bernabé-nonogi, degi, Saulo-nonogi argan mesismalad, adi oyogegar, Bab Dummad wemar-susye, degi, wemar barminabarye. A-sorba gwenadgan Bernabé, degi, Saulo-barmismarsunnad.
Bernabé, Saulo-ebo Chipre-dupse nade-gusad
Bernabé, Saulo-ebo Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-sogedba barmilesmargu, Seleuciase nadmalad, degi, agi mai, urgi Chipre-dupse obakdemar-gusad.
Ar Bernabé, Saulo-ebo Salamina mosmargu, Judiomar-onmaked-negmargi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burbagi sunmakdemalad. Juan-Marcos, emar-bendakegala, eba nadapgusmarmogad.

Bela Chipre-dupugi neggwebur-bukmaladse ataksamargu, Pafosse modapmalad. Agi Judio-wargwen, Barjesúsye-nugad abinguarmalad. A-dulede neled, degi, gakansaar dulemar-yardakdiid, sogdiid, ede Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbegedye.
We-dulede, dule-dummad-wargwen, saila-Sergio-Paulo, dule-binsaed-ibed, aba gudiid. Saila-dummadde Bernabé, degi, Saulo-nik gocha-gusad, ar ade Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itobimogad.
Ar ner-Elimasde, ar deyob e-nug oduloleged, saila-Sergio-Paulo-binsaed ganai-gualid, adi mer Bab-Jesús-igar abingaegar.
Degi Saulo, Pabloye-nugbalid, nue Bab Dummad Burba Nued nikasoggu, ise-atakar Elimasgi atakdegu, ega sogded:
“Be bela-bela aimar-yardaked-dule, be dule-iskana, be nia-saila-machi, ibmar-nued-e-istarad. ¿Bab-Dummad-igar-nued-maid be ichodiid, ade be indakosurde?

Degisoggu, emigindi Bab Dummad begi gwisgunonisunnoed; aku-atake be guoed, ibabigbasaale be dad-ibeler bar dakosulid.” A-sorba, yog Elimasgi nega-sichid nagunonisunnad, aku-atak gunonikid. Degisoggu, aka-aka dule-amidii-gualid, adi argangi e-nidmalagar.
Saila-dummad degi-ibmar-gusad daksagu, Bab-Jesúsgi bar gwen bengussulid, ar ade Bab-Jesús-igar-maid geger nue daked.
Pablo, Bernabébo Antioquía-Pisidia-yargi-siidgi gudigusad
Pablo, degi, eba-gudimalad Pafosgi mai, urgi Pergese obakdemalad, Panfilia-yalaganba. Juan-Marcosdi egi banguded, adi Jerusalénse gannar ali-gusad.
A-sorba Pergegi gudii, nade gusmalad Pisidia-yarse, Antioquía-neggweburse. Degi obunnoged-ibagi Judiomar-onmaked-negse dogdapmalad, agi sigidapmarsunnad.

Moisés-igar-mesisad, degi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-garda-narmaksamalad-absosmalad-sorba, Judiomar-onmaked-neg-e-dummagan Pabloga, degi, Bernabéga sokarmalad: “Gwenadgan, bemar gakagwensaar girmarga ibmar sogbiele, sunna bemar girmar-unaodo.”
Pablo gwisgus imaksagu, argan oyosad, adi bogidik ambikumalagar, nue e-itomalagar. Degi geb sogdesunnad: “Israel-dulemar, degi, bela bemar-Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadimalad, nue an-itomalo:

Bab Dummad, anmar-Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad, anmar-dadgan-susa-gusad. Amba Egipto-yargi maiga gubukwamargu, Bab Dummad anmar-dadgan-omelosad. Geb degi na e-ganguedba a-yargi bukwa onosad, Canaán-yarse sedagegar.
“Birga-dulabosaar nega-dule-sulidganba anmar-dadgan-istar-nanaedba, Bab Dummad anmar-dadgan-bargadii-gusad.
Canaán-yarse anmar-dadgan dognonigu, dulemar-akar-akar-sogagugle-bukmalad obelosad, geb amar-yar Bab Dummad anmar-dadganga uksa-gusad.

We deyob gusadi, birga-dulataled-ilabake-gaka-dulabo-gakambe-wilub (450) deyob gusad. “Geb a-sorba, Bab Dummad anmar-dadganga dule-nabir-igar-nabiromalad ega uksa-gusad, Samuel, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged mai-gusadse.
A-sorba anmar-dadgan, rey-nikubi-guarmalad. Bab Dummadse rey-egichismargu, Bab Dummad ega Saúl, Cis-machi, uksa-gusad. A-dulede, anmar-dad-Benjamín-e-wagwad. Saúl birga-dulabo reyga mai-gusad.
Saúl-reyga-maid Bab Dummad obachagusad, geb David reyga mesnonikid. Bab Dummad David-nik sogsa-gusad:
“Bab Dummad bato iduar igar-mesisadba guegala we-dad-Davidgi Israel-dulemar-abonoged ogwisnonikid. We-dulede Jesúsye-nugad.

Jesús amba yo nonikid-iduar, Juan-Bautista Bab-Dummad-igargi sunmaknonikid, Israel-dulemarga sognonikid: ‘Na be-ulubgi bukib binsamar, be-daed be gwagmarsun, degi, Bab-Dummad-digi-ogleged-igar be imakmarsun.’

Juan e-arbaed-wilubgan bergunaigua, sogde-gusad: ‘¿Doaye bemar an-bimala? ¿Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye be an-bimala? An a-dulesulid. An-sorba-danikiddi anba bur-dule-dummadid, degisoggu, e-sapat-dubse-bakar geg an ei esiked.’
“Gwenadgan, bemar-Abraham-e-waganye-sogbukmalad, degi, bemar-Judiosurmalad degi-inigwele Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadimalad, bemarga we-gaya-burba-nued barmilenaid, adi bemar abonolemalagar.

Ar Jerusaléngi-bukmalad, degi, e-dummagan, Jesús-aku-daksamalad. Degine, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-narmakar-maid, itoged-irba obunnoged-ibagi absodimalan-inigwele, aku amba itosmalad. Degite, dummagan Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-narmakar-naidba imaksamalad, deun Jesús-oburgweye sognonimargu.
Amarde gwen oburgwed-igar Jesúsga mai daksasurmalanad, degite Pilatose egisnanai-gusmalad, ega Jesús-oburgwegar.
Ar igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi Jesúsgi narmakar nai, deyob bela gusgua, nakrusgi-naid odesmargu, geb degi neg-uangi digsa-gusmalad.
“Ar Bab Dummaddi Jesús-burgwar-maid gannar odulos-gusad.
A-Jesús, Galilea-akar-Jerusalénse-eba-nade-gusmaladse na ibbigbasaale magarodii-gusad. A-dulemar emide dulemar-baiganga Jesúsgi na-ibmar-daksamaladba sunmakdimarsunnad.
“We-gaya-burba-nued anmar-dadganga sogles-gusad, anmar bemarga egi sunmakdimarmosundo.
Ar anmar e-wagan gusoggu, anmarga Bab Dummad we-Jesús-burgwar-maid na odulononikid, ar igi bato narmakar Salmo-bogwadgi nai:
Sal. 2:7
“Degi, adi mer Jesús-san nunguegala, Bab Dummad gannar Jesús-odulosye sogedgi, Bab Dummad e-gaya-burbagi bato weyob idu sogsa gusad:
Aga Salmo-baidgi sognaibalid:
“Ar David Bab-Dummad-sogedba e-dulamarga ibmar imaksad. David burgwisgu, e-dadgan-abargi diglesad, geb e-san nungusad. Degisoggu, David na dukin egi sunmaksasulid, Jesús-nik sogsagusad.
Ar we Jesúsdi, Bab Dummad ogwichisad, adi e-san nungussurgusad, ar ade Jesús burgwar-maigu, Bab Dummad odulosad, degisoggu e-san nungussurdo.
“Degisoggu gwenadgan, bemar wisgue-wilubbid, anmar bemarga-sogdiid anmar-gwage-iskudimalad, Jesúsgi nabir gwage iskussuliyob gunoni-daed.
A-ulale, bela dulemar Jesúsgi-bensurmalad, gwage nudaklenoni-daed, ar Moisés-igar-uksaddi geg dule-gwage nudaked.
Degisoggu nue salakarmar, abakalegi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-narmaksad bemar-nik we sogele, deun sogsa-gusgu:
Hab. 1:5
Pablo, degi, e-sordamar Judiomar-onmaked-neggi noarmargu, Judiosurmalad egi wilenagusmalad, adi emarga gannar obunnoged-iba-baidse Jesús-igargi ega sunmakdamalagar.

Pablo, degi, Bernabémala Judiomar-onmaked-neggi ainidmargu, Judiomar, degi, Judio-igar-abingasmalad, Pabloba, degi, Bernabéba bukidar nade-gusmalad. Amarga Pablo sunmakalid, “Nue salakarmarye, bemar Bab-Jesús-igar-amismalad mer a-igar be iemaloye.”
Obunnoged-iba nonigu, neggwebur belasaale ambikunonimalad, adi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itomalagar.
Judiomar dulemar-bukidar-bukwa dakargu, nobgudmalad. Pablo ibmar-soggwichidi ichodmalad, degi, ukabsadmarbalid.

Degi Pablo, Bernabé-ebo nue-dobsuli sunmakdemalad, Judiomarga sogdemarsunnad: “Ar bemargar-insa Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba soglegoye igar soglesanad. Ar bemar abingasurmarsoggu, bemar baisur-dakedba burba-geg-bergued yapa niku-gusmalad. Degisoggu, anmar Judiosurmaladga we-gaya-burba sunmaknamarsunnoed.
Ar Bab Dummad bato deyob anmarga igar uksad, anmarga sogsad:

Judiosurmalad Pablo wegi-soge itosmargu, yeer itodmalad, degi, “Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba, nuedye,” sogdemarsunnad. Degi, bukidar burba-geg-bergued abingaoye ga igar-maidga, amar bela Bab-Jesúsgi-bengussurmalad.
Agi Bab-Jesús-gaya-burba-nued a-yalaganba bela aisakidsunnad.

Ar Judiomardi, omegan nue-Bab-Dummadgi-binsadimaladse, degi, nue-nug-nikamaladse, degi, machergan-neggweburgi-nue-nug-nika-gudimaladse nade-gusmalad, adi Pablo, degi, Bernabé-bareginmalagar. A-yargi a-dulemar Pablo, degi, Bernabé-onoedse imaksamalad.

Pablo, degi, Bernabé-ebo a-neggweburgi nodmargu, e-naggi-olli-nanaid obad-obad imaksamalad. Degi-saedi, sogleged: “An be bar wichur, an bega Bab-Jesús-igargi sunmaksamarmoganad, emigindi na be itolegedmarsundo.” Degi Pablo, degi, Bernabé Iconiose nadmarsunnad.
Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad bela nue-weligwar itosmalad, degi, nue Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-nika gudigusmalad.
